zh.summary: 面向房产中介与物业团队，接电话、筛选需求并把预约写进业务系统。
zh.judgment: 价值在少漏客户且正确回写；语言能力与行业规则比通用语音演示更关键。
zh.replaces: 房产团队逐个接电话、重复询问需求、转接同事并手动补客户记录。
zh.product: 官网明确覆盖电话、短信、WhatsApp 和邮件，列出需求筛选、跟进、预约与文档发送。能力是公司声明，本次没有拨打测试号码。
zh.customer: 中介、租赁、物业管理与业主委员会服务团队是使用者。高峰来电与非营业时段容易出现漏接，付费价值应来自实际恢复的有效需求，而非所有接通电话。
zh.workflow: 公开流程是配置声音与语气、提供业务资料、接入号码，再由代理回答、转接和预约。应检查房源、人员日历与客户系统是否同步，以及不确定问题能否及时升级。
zh.business_model: 本次未取得公开价目，试用与销售演示不能证明收费方式。按通信量、团队或地点定价是可研究假设，电话费用和人工转接应纳入总成本。
zh.traction: 官网列出客户与增长效果，属于公司披露，没有独立对照。客户名录可作为后续访谈线索，不能将宣传中的收入提升归因于代理本身。
zh.moat: 房产业务软件集成与本地行业知识可能有价值。传统外包接听、员工与其他语音代理都能承担部分任务，需要比较完成预约的准确性和长期维护成本。
zh.funding_read: 资本支持地区拓展不代表每个市场已完成部署。房产流程与语言不同，下一里程碑应是同一客户的重复使用，以及新区域的可复用实施。
zh.risks: 房源或价格过期会误导客户，日历写错会增加返工。大量转接若没有上下文，仍可能让员工重复询问；需核对例外处理工时。
zh.takeaway: 先围绕一个行业的真实通信任务完成接听、确认和回写。把电话入口与后台执行共同交付，才能减少运营团队负担。
zh.watch_next: 看有效需求恢复率、预约正确率、漏接变化和人工转接后的重问次数。把宣传接通率与最终服务完成率分开统计。

en.summary: Industry communication agents qualifying property inquiries and recording bookings in business systems.
en.judgment: Avoided missed leads and correct write-back matter more than a fluent voice demo.
en.replaces: Manually answering property calls, qualifying needs, transferring and updating customer records.
en.product: The official site covers calls, SMS, WhatsApp and email, with qualification, follow-up, booking and document delivery. These are company claims; no live number was tested.
en.customer: Agencies, rental teams and property managers are stated users. Peak and after-hours demand creates missed-call pressure. Payment value depends on recovered useful inquiries, not all answered calls.
en.workflow: The described setup configures voice, adds business information and connects a number, then answers, transfers and books. Current listings, calendars, synchronization and escalation need verification.
en.business_model: No public prices were retrieved. Trials and demos do not establish billing. Volume, team or location pricing are hypotheses; telephony and human transfer affect total cost.
en.traction: Customer and growth statements are company-published without an independent comparison. They support follow-up interviews, not attribution of revenue improvements to the agent alone.
en.moat: Property-software integration and local knowledge could differentiate it. Staff, outsourced reception and competing voice agents remain substitutes, compared on correct bookings and maintenance cost.
en.funding_read: Capital can support geographic expansion without proving deployment in every market. Repeat use and reusable implementation across languages are useful milestones.
en.risks: Stale listings or prices can mislead callers and wrong calendars can create rework. Contextless transfers may force staff to repeat questions; exception effort matters.
en.takeaway: Close one industry-specific communication task through answering, confirmation and write-back. Deliver the telephone entry point together with backend execution.
en.watch_next: Watch recovered useful inquiries, booking accuracy, missed calls and repeated questions after transfer. Distinguish answering from completed service.
